description: This file defines a RecyclerView adapter classes for displaying a list of Product items in an Android application, utilizing paging and view binding.

classes.name: ProductAdapter
classes.description: An adapter for paginated displaying of Product items with callback handling for cart operations.

methods.name: setCartCallbacks
methods.description: Sets callback functions for adding, incrementing, and decrementing items in the cart.

classes.name: ProductViewHolder
classes.description: ViewHolder class for binding Product data to item views in the RecyclerView.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds a Product item to the view holder, updating UI elements and setting click listeners.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new ProductViewHolder.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the view holder for a specific position.
